Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4725213. Join activities to assays on assay_id and to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure presence. Filter where assays.chembl_id is CHEMBL4725213, activities.standard_value is not null, and activities.standard_relation is '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
